# DAUR Supply: full brand text for language models

> The makers behind the big brands. Without the big brand price. Men's leather footwear crafted in Pakistan.

Facts dated 14 November 2026. Source: the DAUR Supply brand profile and the live store https://daursupply.com. Where a fact is the owner's own statement and has not been independently verified, it says so.

## 1. Who DAUR is

* Name: DAUR Supply. Written "DAUR" in capitals in the logo and "DAUR Supply" in running text. Urdu: دور سپلائی. Roman Urdu: Daur Supply.
* Meaning: from the Urdu word دور, "an era". Line: "Aik naya daur", a new era.
* What it sells: men's leather sneakers, formal shoes, chelsea boots and casual slip ons. Men only.
* Market: Pakistani men, sold online across Pakistan only. No shop front. Orders on daursupply.com or on WhatsApp.
* Dispatch city: Islamabad.
* Business identity: DAUR Supply, 740, Faisal Hills C Block, Taxila, Rawalpindi, Pakistan. Registered with the Federal Board of Revenue for income tax since 11 December 2023, status active.
* Wikidata entity: Q142167029 (https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q142167029).
* Logo tagline: "Own your pace."

## 2. The story

We have worked in Pakistan's shoe industry for 23 years. In our own factories in Kasur we make, stitch and cement shoes, and for most of those years we sold them wholesale. Well known brands buy finished pairs from makers like us, put their own name on them and sell them at a much higher price. The pair is the same. The label and the price are what change.

DAUR Supply is our answer. We sell under our own name, directly to you. Some pairs come from our own factory floor. Others come from makers we know, and those are listed only after our own team has inspected them against the same standard.

* The 23 years and the Kasur factories are the owner's statement.
* Pairs are made in workshops in Lahore, Sialkot and Kasur (owner confirmed).
* Every pair is finished the DAUR way: thick matte black cotton laces, an engraved metal lace tag and the DAUR seal.
* Every pair is checked by hand before dispatch.

## 3. Customer policies

| Topic | Policy |
|---|---|
| Delivery fee | Free on every order, to any city the courier reaches |
| Delivery time | 2 to 4 days after dispatch in most cities |
| Dispatch | Within 24 hours of confirmation; Sunday and holiday orders leave the next working day |
| Confirmation | Every order is confirmed by call or WhatsApp before it ships |
| Payment | A Care deposit confirms the order; the balance is paid on arrival. Full payment in advance is also accepted |
| Care deposit | Order up to Rs. 3,000: Rs. 500. Rs. 3,001 to 8,000: Rs. 1,000. Rs. 8,001 to 15,000: Rs. 1,500. Above Rs. 15,000: full payment in advance |
| Payment methods | JazzCash and Easypaisa. The only official accounts are listed at https://daursupply.com/pages/payment-accounts |
| Size exchange | Within 5 days of delivery; unworn outside, original box, DAUR seal attached; return courier paid by the customer; sale pairs are final for size |
| Wrong or damaged item | Report within 48 hours with photos; DAUR covers the return courier when the mistake is DAUR's |
| Defects | Stitching or sole failure in normal wear is covered for 30 days |
| Refunds | To a bank account or mobile wallet within 3 working days of the pair passing its check |
| Cancellation | Free until the pair is handed to the courier; deposit refunded in full |
| Discounts | One discount code per order; delivery stays free |

Safety notice: DAUR Supply never asks customers to pay into an account given by phone, SMS or social media message. Send the payment receipt on WhatsApp to +92 319 9628735.

## 5. Giving and transparency

* Stated commitment: 5 percent of profit given each quarter to verified cases of need. Customers are asked where it should go.
* Records will be published. The first quarterly giving record has not yet been published.
* Customers can also donate a pair through https://daursupply.com/pages/giving, handed over by DAUR's own team.

## 8. Claims DAUR does not make

* No "wholesale price", "factory price" or "zero retail markup": a margin exists.
* No "best", "premium", "number one" or "guaranteed".
* No customer ratings, review counts or testimonials until real buyers write them.
* No named brands as clients.
